role: Business Intelligence Engineer , Prime Video Personalization and Discovery
responsibilities: Drive data-based strategic decisions for international video streaming service
Partner with engineering, product, and marketing teams
Set and track program goals and metrics
Design scalable data solutions based on business requirements
Develop reporting dashboards and metrics visualization
Use tools like SQL, ETL, Redshift, QuickSight, and Tableau
Manage complete development lifecycle from design to maintenance

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The only framing language is speed and risk-taking ("fast-paced", "take risks", "dynamic team"), with no quality, testing or governance signal anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: shape how millions of customers worldwide discover and enjoy their favorite shows and movies
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Streaming recommendations affect product decisions without regulatory or financial-reporting stakes, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Use tools like SQL, ETL, Redshift, QuickSight, and Tableau
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An established personalization team inside Prime Video with a standard tool stack in the responsibilities is a mature function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Partner with engineering, product, and marketing teams
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets are short and generic ("Develop reporting dashboards and metrics visualization") and could describe almost any BI role.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: uncover patterns in viewer behavior and translate them into actionable recommendations
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is the personalization product, per "patterns in viewer behavior" and how customers "discover new content".
evidence.autonomy_level: Drive data-based strategic decisions for international video streaming service
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic phrasing ("Drive", "Set and track program goals") sits beside routine delivery ("Develop reporting dashboards").
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The JD expects no AI skill from the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing, data quality and monitoring are not mentioned anywhere.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in impact and delivery terms.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Manage complete development lifecycle from design to maintenance
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design of new data solutions sits beside maintaining existing ones.
